data.label: Website Check
data.title:
5 signs your website is
*losing you customers*
data.sub: Swipe to see if your site is failing.

data.label: Sign #1
data.title: It's not *mobile-friendly*
data.body: Most customers use their phones to find local services. If your site is hard to read on a phone, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Open your site on your phone and test the navigation.

data.label: Sign #2
data.title: It *loads too slowly*
data.body: People are impatient. If your homepage takes more than three seconds to load, potential clients will click away to a competitor.
data.fix: Fix: Compress your high-resolution images to smaller file sizes.

data.label: Sign #3
data.title: No *clear call-to-action*
data.body: Your visitors shouldn't have to guess what to do next. If they can't find your phone number or booking button, they won't call.
data.fix: Fix: Add a bold 'Call Now' button at the top right.

data.label: Sign #4
data.title: Hard to *find information*
data.body: Customers want to know your services, pricing, and area coverage quickly. Hiding this info makes you look unprofessional and disorganized.
data.fix: Fix: Put your service list and service area on the homepage.

data.label: Sign #5
data.title: It looks *outdated*
data.body: A website that looks like it's from 2005 makes people worry you aren't actually in business anymore or don't care about quality.
data.fix: Fix: Update your fonts and photos to look modern and clean.
